overview: Flesh Mongers planet is a star system in the Outer Rim Territories, within the Zuma Sector, at galactic grid R-14, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Flesh Mongers planet appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Outer Rim Territories.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Flesh Mongers planet's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Flesh Mongers planet is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Outer Rim Territories chart.
